name: claude-setup
description: Zack Petersen's personal Claude Code plugins, from the claude-setup repo.

plugins.name: model-discipline
plugins.description: Keeps expensive-model spend on judgment work: a PreToolUse guard that denies unpinned subagent dispatches, an always-on session rules block, and a playbook skill for dispatch and session hygiene.

plugins.name: plan-gate
plugins.description: Blocks ExitPlanMode until /self-review has recorded a pass for this project.

plugins.name: new-day
plugins.description: Nudges Claude to run the daily-auth skill on every prompt until today's login check has run.
